Sinopsis: In a dystopian 1970s America, fifty teenage boys take part in a deadly annual walking contest, forced to maintain a minimum pace or be executed, until only one survivor remains.
Reparto principal: Cooper Hoffman, David Jonsson, Garrett Wareing

Sinopsis: Alpha, a troubled 13-year-old lives with her single mom. Their world collapses the day she returns from school with a tattoo on her arm.
Reparto principal: Mélissa Boros, Tahar Rahim, Golshifteh Farahani

Sinopsis: The foundations of Grayson Manor are shaken when an accident leaves Boyd Grayson handless and his mother invests in radical new technology to help him.
Reparto principal: Chris Colfer, Alice Krige, Daniel Adegboyega

Sinopsis: Three ferocious dogs keep a group of young people prisoners in the pool of a luxurious house they have snuck into, while neighbors gather at a nearby villa to celebrate the start of summer.
Reparto principal: Lara Gallo, Elías Hwidar, Ada Tormo

Sinopsis: In the near future, Paris is divided into three zones that separate social classes, and no one can escape ALMA, a predictive AI that has revolutionized law enforcement. When ALMA’s creator is assassinated, Salia, a top agent, and Zem, a jaded cop, are forced to work together to solve a murder that may expose the dark secrets of the system they serve.
Reparto principal: Gilles Lellouche, Adèle Exarchopoulos, Louis Garrel

Sinopsis: When an over zealous scientist pushes his experiments with string theory too far, his brane explodes. That's "brane", not "brain", meaning someone has to sort out the mess he has created. Corey Harlan is sent in – kicking and screaming – to find the heart of the brane and its creator.
Reparto principal: Sam Riley, Alexandra Maria Lara, Noah Taylor

Sinopsis: A father and daughter accidentally hit and kill a unicorn while en route to a weekend retreat, where his billionaire boss seeks to exploit the creature’s miraculous curative properties.
Reparto principal: Paul Rudd, Jenna Ortega, Will Poulter

Sinopsis: Arnold, an unemployed middle-aged mouse, confides to his wife Maria that he suspects his entire world is nothing more than a set, and his life a scripted performance. When his best friend Ramiro dies under mysterious circumstances, he traces the conspiracy to a monolithic corporation whose influence reaches every corner of their daily lives.
Reparto principal: Asier Hormaza, Aintzane Gamiz, Kandido Uranga

Sinopsis: In modern-day Transylvania, vampire hunts and labor strikes collide with sci-fi twists, romance, and AI-crafted tales, as multiple storylines blend folklore, classic horror, and contemporary elements into a fresh take on Dracula's legend.
Reparto principal: Adonis Tanța, Gabriel Spahiu, Oana Maria Zaharia

Sinopsis: Fleeing from their violent father, siblings Lucía and Adrián take refuge in a remote mansion. With the help of a hidden micro-camera on a cat, Lucía uncovers a terrifying secret: their neighbors are part of a criminal network that kidnaps teenage girls to make snuff films, and they intend to get rid of the siblings. As Lucía fights to protect her brother, she must face a dark family curse that follows them into their newfound sanctuary.
Reparto principal: Ana Clara Guanco, Marcelo Michinaux, Luciano Cáceres

Sinopsis: After a tragic loss, a grieving father tries to raise his young sons whilst dealing with an unlikely, unpredictable, and uninvited houseguest.
Reparto principal: Benedict Cumberbatch, David Thewlis, Sam Spruell

Sinopsis: A man trapped in an endless sterile subway passageway sets out to find Exit 8. The rules of his quest are simple: do not overlook anything out of the ordinary. If you discover an anomaly, turn back immediately. If you don’t, carry on. Then leave from Exit 8. But even a single oversight will send him back to the beginning. Will he ever reach his goal and escape this infinite corridor?
Reparto principal: Kazunari Ninomiya, Yamato Kochi, Naru Asanuma

Sinopsis: Anna, grieving the sudden death of her parents, relocates from New York to a small Florida town to live with the grandmother she has never met. Isolated, vulnerable, and in need of friends, she finds brief solace in the company of two local teens. But when she becomes complicit to their unforgivable act of violence, she finds herself ensnared by Mr. Sandman – the twisted soul of a tormented child who haunts bullies’ dreams before feasting on their eyeballs when they finally wake - Anna must right her wrong before becoming a victim of this gruesome curse.
Reparto principal: Whitney Peak, Golda Rosheuvel, Finn Bennett

Sinopsis: Spain, Basque Country, 17th century. At night and through the mountains, Kattalin escapes from her farmhouse and, while wandering through the deep forest, she senses a presence that stalks her.
Reparto principal: Yune Nogueiras, Ane Gabarain, Elena Irureta

Sinopsis: A loyal dog moves to a rural family home with his owner Todd, only to discover supernatural forces lurking in the shadows. As dark entities threaten his human companion, the brave pup must fight to protect the one he loves most.
Reparto principal: Shane Jensen, Arielle Friedman, Larry Fessenden

Sinopsis: Nawojka, 20, dreams of escaping her harsh life working at the family farm. Under the influence of the free-spirited Sandra, Naw experiences trance-like episodes and strange powers, just like her dead mother before her…
Reparto principal: Maria Wróbel, Roxane Mesquida, Wojciech Skibiński

Sinopsis: Diana's husband is taking her to an experimental trauma facility deep in the wilderness, but she can't remember why... As her memories begin to creep back in so do some unwelcome sinister truths about her marriage.
Reparto principal: Grace Glowicki, Ben Petrie, Jason Isaacs

Sinopsis: In a fairy-tale kingdom where beauty is a brutal business, Elvira battles to compete with her incredibly beautiful stepsister, and she will go to any length to catch the prince’s eye.
Reparto principal: Lea Myren, Ane Dahl Torp, Thea Sofie Loch Næss

Sinopsis: In a remote village on the island of Carpathia, a shy farm girl named Yuri is raised to fear an elusive animal species known as ochi. But when Yuri discovers a wounded baby ochi has been left behind, she escapes on a quest to bring him home.
Reparto principal: Helena Zengel, Willem Dafoe, Emily Watson

Sinopsis: In this extraordinary story of an ordinary man, Charles 'Chuck' Krantz experiences the wonder of love, the heartbreak of loss, and the multitudes contained in all of us.
Reparto principal: Tom Hiddleston, Benjamin Pajak, Nick Offerman
